lines.t: Beloved, this word, even every volume to every letter, is the word of my glory which I have put forth once again.
A testament of my love and sacrifice
Revelation of who I really am
So all those called and chosen may hear
And come to me in their proper time and season
reason, behold, it is also a strong correction for all those who have taken to themselves
my name and my word, to pollute it, a plumb line for this wicked generation, for this
word is a waving banner, an insight to all nations, a trumpet of alarm and war, the sound
A round of recompense and judgement which shall soon fall upon every nation!
The only begotten of the fatherhood
The one true God and Savior
